zh.title: 阿聯酋航空A380首降雅加達 運送AC米蘭團隊返歐
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空A380於8月8日首度飛抵雅加達；載運AC米蘭球隊返回義大利
body: 阿聯酋航空空中巴士A380客機於2026年8月8日首度降落印尼雅加達蘇凱諾-哈達國際機場（CGK）。該架雙層客機在AC米蘭足球俱樂部於印尼季前巡迴賽與切爾西足球俱樂部完成友誼賽後，負責將AC米蘭全隊載運返回義大利。
阿聯酋航空印尼區域經理 Majid Alfalasi 表示，公司對於首次將 A380 引進雅加達並載運 AC 米蘭返國感到自豪。該機於8月8日抵達雅加達，並於次日凌晨過後起飛離境。阿聯酋航空目前每週營運14班往返雅加達與杜拜的航班，並提供每天2班往返登巴薩伊古斯蒂·努拉·萊國際機場（DPS）與杜拜的服務。

en.title: Emirates Airbus A380 Makes First Jakarta Landing to Fly AC Milan Team Home
en.summary: Emirates flew an Airbus A380 to Jakarta for the first time, transporting AC Milan back to Italy.
body: An Emirates Airbus A380 landed at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK) in Jakarta for the first time on August 8, 2026. The double-decker aircraft carried the AC Milan squad back to Italy following the football club's pre-season tour friendly against Chelsea FC in Indonesia.

Majid Alfalasi, Emirates Country Manager for Indonesia, stated that the airline was proud to bring the A380 to Jakarta for the first time while flying AC Milan home. The aircraft arrived in Jakarta on August 8 and departed shortly after midnight the following day. Emirates currently operates 14 weekly flights between Jakarta and Dubai, as well as two daily flights between I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS) in Denpasar and Dubai.

zh.title: 歐洲多家航空公司於8月12日推出日全食觀測航班
zh.summary: 西班牙航空與布魯塞爾航空安排特別航班，搭載乘客與學者在高空觀賞日食。
body: 歐洲多家航空公司於2026年8月12日日全食期間安排特別觀測航班。其中西班牙航空將使用空中巴士A321XLR客機執行IB1473航班，從馬德里起飛前往巴倫西亞省上空觀測日全食，並將搭載Shelios計畫的科研人員，透過星鏈衛星網路進行全程直播。
此外，布魯塞爾航空與當地天文台合作，以空中巴士A320客機搭載100名乘客從布魯塞爾起飛前往法國西部觀賞偏食。比利時ASL集團旗下的ACE亦透過巴西航空工業ERJ135專機提供由列日機場起飛的包機觀測服務。

en.title: Airlines Prepare Special Flights for August 12 Solar Eclipse
en.summary: Iberia and Brussels Airlines offer special flights to provide high-altitude solar eclipse views for passengers and scientists.
body: Airlines are operating special observation flights for the total solar eclipse on August 12, 2026. Spanish carrier Iberia will operate flight IB1473 from Madrid over Palencia province using an Airbus A321XLR. The flight will carry researchers from the Shelios Project and livestream the astronomical event using Starlink satellite connectivity.

Brussels Airlines is also operating an Airbus A320 flight from Brussels carrying 100 passengers towards western France for partial eclipse viewing in coordination with local observatories. Additionally, ACE, part of Belgian aviation charter company ASL Group, will operate an Embraer ERJ135 regional jet flight departing from Liège Airport.
